related.title: 離岸風電海纜登陸工程
related.titleEn: Offshore Wind Export Cable Landfall Engineering
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮式平台的靜傾角」與「二十五年的波浪循環數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；離岸風電海纜登陸工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Static heel of a floating platform" and "Wave cycles in twenty-five years" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Offshore Wind Export Cable Landfall Engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦隨著浮台一起動的電纜：惰波形構型、浮力模組、彎曲應變與波浪疲勞；離岸風電海纜登陸工程則以海纜上岸的最後一公里：水平導向鑽掘、拉纜張力、深埋段的散熱瓶頸與故障定位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A cable that moves with the floater: the lazy-wave shape, buoyancy modules, bending strain and wave fatigue; Offshore Wind Export Cable Landfall Engineering centres on the last kilometre where a sea cable comes ashore: horizontal directional drilling, pulling tension, the thermal bottleneck of deep burial and fault location, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「惰波形所需的浮力模組」的模型移到離岸風電海纜登陸工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「海上安裝的天氣窗」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Buoyancy modules needed for a lazy wave" to Offshore Wind Export Cable Landfall Engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Weather windows for offshore installation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「浮式平台的靜傾角」與「二十五年的波浪循環數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；離岸風電海纜登陸工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Static heel of a floating platform" and "Wave cycles in twenty-five years" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Offshore Wind Export Cable Landfall Engineering must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 浮式風機動態電纜設計
history.text: 2009 年首部百萬瓦級浮式風機以動態電纜併網；2017 年首座浮式風場啟用，採 33 kV 動態電纜；2021 年66 kV 動態電纜投入商業運轉；2023 年水深近 300 m 的浮式風場啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2009: The first megawatt-class floating turbine was connected by dynamic cable. 2017: The first floating wind farm opened with 33 kV dynamic cables. 2021: 66 kV dynamic cables entered commercial service. 2023: A floating farm in nearly 300 m of water opened. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
